items.title: Fortive Stock Outlook: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish?
items.summary: While Fortive has outperformed the broader market over the past year, Wall Street analysts are cautious about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: 3 Reasons FTV is Risky and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
items.summary: Since February 2026, Fortive has been in a holding pattern, posting a small return of 1.6% while floating around $61.09. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500’s 11.7% gain during that period.

items.title: FTV Q2 Deep Dive: Organic Growth, Margin Expansion, and Strategic Product Investments
items.summary: Industrial technology company Fortive (NYSE:FTV) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 7.9% year on year to $1.10 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.74 per share was 4.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
